payload.root_cause: In `slugify` (src/text.js:11), the whitespace/dash-collapsing replace uses the regex `/[\s-]+/` WITHOUT the global flag: `.replace(/[\s-]+/, '-')`. String.prototype.replace with a non-global regex only substitutes the first match, so only the first run of whitespace/dashes is converted to a dash; every subsequent gap (e.g., the double space between 'big' and 'world' in 'Hello Big  World!') is left as-is, yielding 'hello-big  world' instead of 'hello-big-world'. The neighboring replaces on lines 10 and 12 correctly carry the `g` flag, which makes the omission on line 11 clearly the defect. The fix is to use `/[\s-]+/g` so ALL whitespace/dash runs are collapsed to single dashes (this also fixes the second assertion, where 'already-slugged  title' currently keeps its double space because the first `\s-` run matched is the pre-existing dash).
